comments.body: Do the interpreters restock translation notes at some point? So if he has none for sale when I check, is it worth like taking a short break and checking again in 10 mins or something?

comments.author: Naoyasu

comments.author: Visitor
comments.body:
To summarize and add to the above comments, these notes are sold in the following cities:

Tunis
Alexandria
Istanbul
Aden
Calicut

If the Interpreter NPC is sold out, they will restock every five minutes, real life time.
